entries.note: The forwarder's electronic air waybill reached Cargolux; the goods are not handed over yet.
The goods are in Cargolux's warehouse at origin.
A flight manifest records an assignment before the departure, so it keeps the stage before it.
Taken over from another airline at a transfer.
Handed to another airline at a transfer.
The waybill's papers reached the destination, which can precede the goods, so it keeps the stage before it.
The consignee or its agent collects the goods from the cargo terminal. Away from the waybill's destination the parser files it in transit.
The papers are handed to the consignee or its agent; the goods wait for collection. Away from the waybill's destination the parser files it in transit.
A delivery of part of the pieces delivers the waybill only once all its pieces are delivered.
